senses.gloss: m. (preced.) a part, esp. (collect. noun) split and dried pomegranates.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:6">Maasr. I, 6</cite> <he>הפ׳ והצימוקין וכ׳</he> dried pomegranates and raisins &c.
Tosef. Shebi. VI, 29 מפרדין רימונים לעשותן פ׳ (ed. Zuck. מְפָרְרִין … פֶּרֶר; Var. פרך; some ed. פריך, corr. acc.) you may (in the Sabbatical year) cut pomegranates to make them pered.

Tosef. Ter. III, 16 רימונים ועתיד לעשותן פ׳ Var. ed. Zuck. (ed. Zuck. פראנר; oth. ed. כרי, corr. acc.) if one gives T’rumah of pomegranates (intended for sale), with the intention eventually to cut and store them as pered; a. e.
